title: Here’s what Boston archaeologists found under Bunker Hill Monument
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Local News The excavation uncovered part of a 1775 defensive ditch, musket balls, gunflints, and artifacts left by British soldiers.
Calla Ruff, an intern from Carleton College, sifts dirt removed from an archaeological dig at the site of the Battle of Bunker Hill, Monday, June 15, 2026, in Boston.

AP Photo/Charles Krupa Two months after archaeologists unearthed musket balls and remnants of a Revolutionary War fortification under the Bunker Hill Monument grounds in Charlestown, researchers say the completed excavation has revealed new details about the battlefield and the soldiers who occupied it.
